etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Japanese 豆腐(とうふ) (tōfu), from Middle Chinese 豆腐 (dəu bɨo, “curdled bean”). Doublet of dubu.

definitions.definition: A protein-rich food made from curdled soy milk.

quote.citation: 2012 May 8, Yotam Ottolenghi, Sami Tamimi, Ottolenghi: The Cookbook‎[1], Random House, →ISBN, page 79:
quote.text: First, marinate the tofu. In a bowl, whisk the kecap manis, chilli sauce, and sesame oil together. Cut the tofu into strips about 1cm thick, mix gently (so it doesn't break) with the marinade and leave in the fridge for half an hour.

definitions.definition: (computing, typography) A box or rectangle, empty or with a question mark or hexadecimal code inside, displayed by some systems in place of a character not supported by available fonts. (such as □ or 𐕪)
